lines.text: The proposal is for emergency restoration of storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation, seeking administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore by the Commissioner.
In File USD01-WRKS0/18/2023-WORKS, Note #4, on 04-08-2023, it was decided: 5. Seen. Recorded.
In File USD01-WRKS0/52/2024-WORKS, Note #4, on 21-10-2024, it was decided: 6. Approved. Issue G.O.
AP-USD01-GOMS-27-2024, dated 06-08-2024, issued orders regarding revision of delegation of powers for according administrative sanction to works, including emergency works.
Under AP-USD01-GOMS-27-2024#para-2.vi, works, including emergency works, costing above Rs.1.00 crore require administrative sanction from Government only.
The proposal seeks administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore by the Commissioner.
Under AP-USD01-GOMS-27-2024#para-2.vi, the competent authority for works costing above Rs.1.00 crore is Government only.
Review recommended: verify the authority as the proposal relies on AP-USD01-CIRMEMO-USD01WRKS0-9-2023-D20230711, which was not found among indexed records.
Review recommended: submit to Government, as the proposal seeks approval by Commissioner, who is not the competent authority under AP-USD01-GOMS-27-2024#para-2.vi.

It is submitted that the proposal for administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore for emergency restoration of storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation may kindly be considered for submission to the Government.
